turns.tutor:
Hello! Look at this example. "I cook rice." Now with she: "She cooks rice." I add -s because the subject is she.
Rule: after he, she or it, add -s to the verb, or -es after verbs like wash.
Right: "She cooks rice every day." Wrong: "She cook rice every day."
Now you try. Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
